svg.aria-label: Liquid Glass: Apple-style Liquid Glass for Flutter. Open source · rendering. Runtime GLSL fragment shaders, five SDF shapes, a stable-fluids simulation and adaptive rendering tiers with accessible fallbacks. Stack: Flutter, Dart, GLSL, Kotlin. 36 commits, 10 test files, example app. Opens the liquid_glass repository on GitHub.
